mapper.select: SELECT bbs10_biz_share_id AS biz_share_id , bbs10_date AS date , bbs10_biz_share_type AS biz_share_type , f_cdnm('BizShareType', bbs10_biz_share_type, bbs10_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS biz_share_type_name , bbs10_content AS content , bbs10_keyword AS keyword , bbs10_note AS note , bbs10_person_id AS person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(bbs10_person_id) AS person_name FROM bbs10_biz_share WHERE bbs10_company_id = #{companyId} AND bbs10_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND bbs10_biz_share_type LIKE #{bizShareType} AND UPPER(CONCAT(bbs10_content, f_emp_kor_nm(bbs10_person_id), bbs10_note, bbs10_keyword)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY bbs10_date DESC, bbs10_content COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"
